rec.name: PDP Bulletpoints (USP List with Custom Icons)

what.text: A block in the PDP buy box (main-product) that shows a short list of key benefits or USPs above the fold, near the title, variants and add-to-cart button. Each bullet can use a standard disc, circle or number marker, or a custom icon (SVG or uploaded image, e.g. a green check). The list can be shown plain or inside a box with background, border and rounded corners. Bullet text comes from a product metafield, and individual words can be bold in the examples shown (e.g. 'with **probiotics**').

why.text: Shoppers scan rather than read. Short, scannable benefit bullets close to the price and CTA communicate the core value proposition quickly and cut the effort of reading the description. Check icons act as small reassurances (included extras, free shipping, no damage), which lowers perceived risk. Bolding key terms guides the eye to the strongest selling points. Product-specific bullets keep the message relevant.

how.text:
1) In main-product.liquid, add the schema block 'cro_bulletpoints' (limit 1) with settings for spacing, border, colors, list style, SVG/image icon and font sizes. 2) Create the snippet ed-cro-bulletpoints.liquid, which loops over the metafield list values and renders a
    with optional icon spans and

    text, using CSS variables for colors. 3) In product-form.liquid, add a `when 'cro_bulletpoints'` case that renders the snippet. 4) Create the product metafield definition 'CRO | PDP | Bulletpoints' with key standard.cro_pdp_bulletpoints (Single line text, list of values). 5) In the theme editor, add the block to the product template, position it below the variant picker, and fill the metafield per product. Note: the snippet falls back to theme colors when color settings are left transparent. Known code issues: the media query is written `max-with` (typo, so the mobile font size never applies) and the setting key `icon_margin_rigght` is misspelled.

items: Show border (checkbox), border color, corner radius (0–16px)
List style: Disc / Circle / Decimal / SVG
Icon as image (image picker) or Icon as SVG (HTML field, default check mark)

dependencies.text: Product metafield standard.cro_pdp_bulletpoints (Single line text, list of values). The original ticket asked for up to 5 bullets and rich text (bold/italic/underline) in the headline and bullets, but the delivered code outputs plain {{ value }} without a headline setting, so rich text depends on the metafield value containing HTML or on a rich-text field. The ticket's custom field says 'MF/N' (metafield needed: no), which conflicts with the delivered metafield-based build. A theme with main-product.liquid blocks and a product-form.liquid snippet is assumed. No app required.
